sourceNote: Visually transcribed from PDF pages 24–37 (printed pages 22–35) of the supplied scanned workbook. English outcome wording is supplied only in English; no Nepali translation is invented. All legible theme tables are included. Nine themes are complete; Our Culture is limited to 15 fully visible rows because PDF page 32 is blurred and cropped. Our Environment lists 24 rows despite a printed total of 22; Hobbies and Interests lists 24 despite a printed total of 26. The cumulative record states 236 outcomes overall. Twelve published example rubrics on PDF pages 24–25 are attached to the same outcomes wherever they recur; no additional rubrics or missing rows are invented. Source page numbers refer to one-based PDF pages.

sourceIssues.details: 15 fully visible outcomes transcribed. Reading item 5 is cut off and the remaining Reading/Writing rows are missing from the source photograph; the cumulative record states 25 outcomes.
